note: Engine cases for the Phase 5 BKM exhibit (bkm.l4, spec §6.2). What these
pin that the hand-written dmn-bkm-probe fixtures do not: that
jl4-core/src/L4/Dmn/Lower.hs EMITS the shapes — a red run on a probe
isolates the engine, a red run here isolates the lowering.
The BKMs (weighted_sum, boosted, adjusted) are not named in `expect`:
a businessKnowledgeModel is a function, not a decision, and the cases
schema keys expectations on decision names only — a RECORDED LIMITATION
of both harnesses (spec §13.6; a BKM's value is asserted through its
callers, which is what every expectation below does).
What each value attests: case_one/case_two exercise the BKM→BKM chain
(boosted -> weighted_sum, the knowledgeRequirement on the CALLING BKM,
probe C1's shape, emitted); pay_hydrated + pay_check exercise a BKM
invocation INSIDE a boxed-context entry over earlier sibling entries
(probes B1/B2, emitted); adj_one/adj_two exercise the λ-LIFTED CLOSURE —
their rendered call sites read `adjusted(y: 1, baseline: baseline)`, so
a wrong value here means the lift bound the wrong environment.
